Because we know the women who carry Vera Bradley don't just move through the world, they make things happen in it. When you give Vera Bradley as a gift, you're giving more than a bag or accessory. You're giving craftsmanship passed down through generations, creativity stitched into every seam, and a reminder that function and beauty aren't opposites; they're partners. That's the magic of our Heritage Collection. These are the styles that built our legacy, updated for today's independent, inspired, can-do-it-all woman. Original Vera Tote: A Classic Designed to Handle Your Everyday Life Meet the tote that started it all! This classic large tote has a zip-top closure and longer straps for even more ease. Our Original Vera Tote is your reliable, go-anywhere companion with space for your wallet, planner, snacks, and that “just-in-case” extra layer. "The fabric and color are fabulous!" ~ Maya With smart interior pockets and a sleek exterior slip pocket, this is what timeless functionality looks like when it has great taste. This is the perfect gift for that friend who's always down for anything and somehow always seems effortlessly put-together. items.title: A Little Thanks Goes a Long Way
items.summary: There’s something special about the little things, like a handwritten note or a soft blanket, that actually stick with us. These little things are how we say thank you without saying much at all. Turn everyday kindness into something memorable with one of our favorite thank you gifts that are beautiful, useful, and made to wrap your gratitude in style. Plush Throw Blanket: The Hug You Can Actually Gift Sometimes gratitude looks like warmth! Our Plush Throw Blanket is that soft, comforting gesture everyone appreciates but rarely buys for themselves. The ultra-soft feel is like a hug that lasts way past the holiday season. Generously sized (50" x 80"), this throw blanket is perfect for curling up on the couch, movie marathons, or a much-needed afternoon nap. Whether it's part of a care package or wrapped up with a handwritten note, this throw says, “You matter to me.” "I love Vera Bradley Throw Blankets. Still soft and just the right size for me!" ~ Diane ⭐ Tip: personalize this throw blanket with her name or initials to make it even more meaningful. Just look for the “Personalize this Style” button! 3 Pouch Organizer Set: For the One Who's Always Got It Together Gratitude meets practicality with our 3 Pouch Organizer Set, a trio that's as stylish as it is smart. Each pouch fits seamlessly into a busy day, whether that means keeping makeup in place, chargers in order, or travel essentials ready to go. Because we believe organization shouldn't be boring, each pouch pops with color and pattern, little bursts of joy tucked inside a tote. It's the perfect “thank you” for the friend who somehow manages to stay chic and on time. "Love them! Perfect for traveling!" ~ Kristine Brush Up Cosmetic Case: Proof That Practical Can Still Be Pretty A thank you note slipped inside the Brush Up Cosmetic Case turns a thoughtful gift into a personal treasure. Designed for the woman who’s always on the move, but refuses to compromise on style, this case features: • two zip pockets • two slip pockets • eight brush loops with a protective TPU cover • wipe-clean interior The structured shape makes it ideal for travel, while the design, equal parts elegance and function, feels like a daily reminder that self-care is worth celebrating. "Perfect cosmetic bag! Ample compartments and nice pattern." ~ Denise Mini Roxbury Crescent Shoulder Bag: Small Bag, Big Personality Gratitude doesn't need to shout to make an impression. The Mini Roxbury Crescent Shoulder Bag proves it. With its sleek, crescent silhouette and lightweight design, it's the definition of effortless style. This handbag's minimalist shape and unique pattern let your personality do the talking. Customize the fit the adjustable strap so it's perfect for days out or nights in motion. For the friend who carries herself with quiet confidence, this one says, “I adore your style.” "This is a beautiful bag. Dresses up any outfit." ~ Patricia Original 100 Handbag: A True Classic For the woman who appreciates timeless beauty and thoughtful design, the Original 100 Handbag is a heartfelt nod to those qualities. Its versatile silhouette, slip pockets, and zip closure blend practicality with a sense of heritage. Gifting this bag feels like passing on a little piece of history, an acknowledgment of all the moments, big and small, that connect us. After all, gratitude is timeless, and so is good design. "This is gorgeous and happy the classic style is back." ~ Mary Gift Card: Because Sometimes They Know Exactly What They Want Sometimes the sweetest thank-you is the one that lets her choose. A Vera Bradley Gift Card is the perfect, no-guessing-necessary gesture. It's ideal for the independent woman who already knows her style and is ready to choose it. Whether tucked into a handwritten note or paired with one of our favorites above, it says: "I appreciate you. Go ahead, pick what you love." Wrap Your Thanks in Something Beautiful Sometimes a simple thank you just isn't enough. And that's okay, because you have a knack for expressing gratitude in your own creative way! Whether it's a blanket that comforts, a handbag that carries memories, or a gift card that lets them decide, every Vera Bradley piece was designed with gratitude at heart. This season, let your appreciation take shape in color, texture, and pattern. Because when your thanks come from the heart, and maybe wrapped in a little quilted fabric, it's not just a gift. It's a moment of connection. SHOP ALL GIFTS
